text: Volume and Surface Area · 1. A right triangular prism is shown below. Which statement is true? The prism has three triangular faces and two rectangular faces. The prism has two triangular faces and two rectangular faces. The prism has two triangular faces and three rectangular faces. The prism has three triangular faces and three rectangular faces.
html: Choose the matching letter marked on the question.
answerHtml:
Answer and method

Correct option: C.

Prism volume = cross-sectional area × length. Surface area is the sum of the exposed faces; exclude any open face or cut-out. Cylinder volume = πr²h. Convert volume using 1000 mm³ = 1 cm³, 1000 cm³ = 1 L and 1 m³ = 1 kL.
